name: OrderCervicalTreatment
title: Order Cervical Pre-Cancer Treatment
description: Activity template for ordering treatment of cervical pre-cancer lesions following a positive triage result, per WHO Algorithm 5. The proposal is generic; the specific modality (thermal ablation, cryotherapy, LEEP, or excision) is selected at the plan/order phase based on ablation eligibility, lesion size, and CIN grade per the CervicalCancerTreatment PlanDefinition logic.
purpose: Provide a canonical template for the act of ordering treatment of cervical pre-cancer lesions, suitable for the proposal phase of the FHIR CPG Activity Flow. Modality refinement (ablation vs. excision) occurs in the downstream plan/order transitions.
